dedupe_keys.name: rye microgrid load and generation data and meteorological forecasts

description: Per Aaslid at SINTEF Energy Research publishes load, solar-generation and wind-generation time series for the Rye microgrid near Trondheim, Norway. The pilot supplies a farm and three households and is designed around renewable generation, a battery and hydrogen storage. A CSV gives consumption and generation in kilowatts with UTC time stamps. An HDF5 file contains historical Norwegian Meteorological Institute forecasts issued every six hours, including temperature, pressure, cloud cover, radiation and wind. The June 2021 deposit is free under CC BY 4.0. Full temporal coverage and the load-sampling interval are not stated in the public description. These inputs support dispatch and islanding simulations, but storage-state measurements are not listed among the released channels. No related catalogue record is explicitly identified. The metadata link further pilot documentation and a hackathon repository.
